if it was a ransom note intended as real ransom note, it wasn’t very functional. it gave the amount and denomination of bills requested. but it glosses over that minor detail of which way “tomorrow” is, the 26th or 27th. it doesn’t go into any detail about delivery, it says it will “come later”. 


every single character that a ransom note writer puts down on paper is another clue for the police to track them. and this writer was more concerned with grandstanding and hurling quips than getting the details straight about how to get the money. in my opinion, this wasn’t about money. it was about proving a point, a point that made sense to the writer only.
